title: Planet Putt
tagline: Mini-golf in space, where planets bend every shot.
help: Press, drag back and let go to shoot. Planets pull on your ball. Sink it in the wormhole in as few strokes as you can.

card.background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(255, 111, 181, 0.35), transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, rgba(94, 224, 255, 0.3), transparent 45%), #0e0c22
